title: Polymarket User Position Tracker
description: Tracks current open positions for a specific Polymarket user by wallet address. Monitor what markets a trader is in, their cost basis, and unrealized P&L. Set the POLYMARKET_USER_ADDRESS credential to the wallet address you want to track.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DATA = 'https://data-api.polymarket.com'
user_addr = CREDENTIALS['POLYMARKET_USER_ADDRESS']

resp = requests.get(
    f'{DATA}/positions',
    params={'user': user_addr},
    timeout=30,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
data = resp.json()

positions = data
if isinstance(data, dict):
    positions = data.get('data', data.get('positions', []))

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
rows = []
for pos in positions:
    rows.append({
        'user_address': user_addr,
        'condition_id': pos.get('conditionId', pos.get('condition_id', '')),
        'asset_id': pos.get('assetId', pos.get('asset_id', '')),
        'question': pos.get('question', pos.get('title', '')),
        'slug': pos.get('slug', ''),
        'outcome': pos.get('outcome', ''),
        'outcome_index': pos.get('outcomeIndex', pos.get('outcome_index', '')),
        'size': float(pos.get('size', pos.get('quantity', 0)) or 0),
        'avg_price': float(pos.get('avgPrice', pos.get('average_price', 0)) or 0),
        'current_price': float(pos.get('currentPrice', pos.get('current_price', 0)) or 0),
        'initial_value': float(pos.get('initialValue', 0) or 0),
        'current_value': float(pos.get('currentValue', 0) or 0),
        'pnl': float(pos.get('pnl', pos.get('unrealized_pnl', 0)) or 0),
        'realized_pnl': float(pos.get('realizedPnl', pos.get('realized_pnl', 0)) or 0),
        'cashflow': float(pos.get('cashflow', 0) or 0),
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
